playgroundPanel.interactiveHoverButtonDesc: On hover the label slides away, a primary blob expands to fill the button, revealing the label with an arrow.
playgroundPanel.chapterScrubberDesc: Hover or use arrow keys to ride the wave ticks; the preview card follows the pointer. Click or press Enter to select.
playgroundPanel.folderDesc: Papers fan out and lift on hover. Three sizes and six colors.
playgroundPanel.galleryDesc: Click the stacked photos to expand into a grid; click outside or Go back to collapse (demo images are external links).
playgroundPanel.fileSystemDesc: Finder-style icon/list/columns/gallery views with search, sorting, file-type and date filters, lazy folder loading and full keyboard navigation (demo images are external links).
playgroundPanel.fileIconDesc: Matches vscode-style icons by filename/extension/folder name, falling back to defaults for unknown types.
playgroundPanel.fileCardDesc: Renders skeleton placeholders per format (document/table/archive weave/code tags) with a colored format badge.
playgroundPanel.colorPickerDesc: Swatches support size/shape variants and a transparency checkerboard; channel sliders (hue/alpha) with labels and values inside the popover; the last demo customizes the trigger via slot.
playgroundPanel.typeDesc: Different types correspond to different left color bars and icons. Click to trigger a notification in the bottom-right corner.
playgroundPanel.positionDesc: Notifications can appear at different screen positions (bottom-right by default).
playgroundPanel.imagesNotificationBody: Images are displayed on the left side of the notification (images field)
playgroundPanel.animationDesc: slide automatically slides in from the corresponding direction based on the screen position (from right for bottom-right, from left for bottom-left).
playgroundPanel.notElectronDesc: Notification windows require Electron. Currently running in a browser, demo unavailable.
playgroundPanel.openDesktop: Please open this page in the desktop app.
playgroundPanel.formIntroDesc: Pass a zod schema + field metadata array; the component renders, validates, and submits automatically. No manual errors / validateForm needed.

playgroundPanel.pageSlidePage2Body: Each page is absolutely positioned to fill the container. Use the controls below to tweak the transition live.
